title: WorldPop Gridded Population Counts for Algeria (100 m)
description: Gridded estimates of the number of people per ~100 m (3 arc-second) grid cell for Algeria, produced by WorldPop (University of Southampton) by Random Forest-based dasymetric redistribution of census-based population counts. The current series is the 'Global2' R2025A release with annual constrained estimates 2015-2030; earlier releases cover 2000-2020 (unconstrained) and 2020 (constrained).
purpose: Exposure denominator for hazard, drought and access analyses in Algeria (e.g. population exposed to heat, flood, fire or air pollution), and for aggregating population to wilayas or communes.

spatial_extent.description: Country file for Algeria (DZA) on the WorldPop mastergrid; cells outside mapped settlements are NoData in constrained products.

temporal_extent.description: Global2 R2025A: annual constrained estimates 2015-2030 (16 Algeria files, years beyond the input data are projections aligned to UN WPP 2024 national totals for 1 January). Earlier releases: unconstrained 2000-2020 annual (WP00645, 2018) and constrained 2020 (WP00684, 2020).

variables.name: population
variables.description: Estimated total number of people per ~100 m grid cell (float32; NoData -99999)

processing: Subnational census-based population counts are interpolated/projected to annual totals aligned with UN World Population Prospects 2024, then disaggregated to 3 arc-second cells with a Random Forest population-density weighting layer (500 trees) built from a fixed global covariate stack (terrain, climate, night lights, land cover, roads, water, protected areas). Constrained products only allocate population to cells mapped as settled by a built-settlement growth model using GHSL BUILT-S/BUILT-V, Google Open Buildings V3, Microsoft Building Footprints and the World Settlement Footprint.
limitations: Modeled estimates, not observations: accuracy varies by country and year and is not quantified per cell in the release statement.

For Algeria, the R2025A census-sources sheet lists a single time point: the 2008 RGPH census (Office National des Statistiques) at admin level 2 with 1,540 units; all later years (2015-2030) are projections constrained to UN WPP 2024 national totals, so subnational change since 2008 is modeled.
R2025A is described by WorldPop as an alpha release that 'may change over the coming year'.
Comparisons between years should be made with care at small-area scales; the release statement warns of possible unnatural spatial discontinuities.
Does not account for seasonal or nomadic population mobility (relevant to pastoral steppe and Saharan populations) or rapid-onset displacement.

algeria_notes: Algeria's inputs date from the 2008 census only (per WorldPop's R2025A census-sources sheet), so the 2015-2030 grids are projections; national totals follow UN WPP 2024. Do not present cell values as counts of residents in a specific settlement.

verification.notes: Newer 'Global2' series confirmed: REST aliases G2_CN_POP_R25A_100m ('Individual countries 2015-2030 (100m resolution) R2025A v1'), also R2024B constrained/unconstrained and 2024-only series. bbox, CRS, data type and NoData read by AEO from the downloaded 2025 GeoTIFF header (rasterio, 2026-11-19); AEO check: the 2025 raster sums to about 47.13 million people (computed by AEO, not a provider figure). spatial_m 93 is 3 arc-seconds at the equator (~92.6 m). published_date = 'date' field of the R2025A records (2025-09-01). Methods and Algeria census inputs from the release statement and the census-sources spreadsheet (row DZA).
